topic: What antenna design considerations minimize signal attenuation in high-noise power line environments for reliable PLC integration?
consensus_response: Optimizing antenna spacing, adaptive impedance matching, and frequency selection minimizes signal attenuation. Impedance mismatch can lead to reflection, exacerbating attenuation. Adaptive modulation techniques and robust error correction mechanisms also mitigate noise effects, ensuring reliable communication.
reference_context: PLC faces challenges from signal attenuation, distortion, and high noise sources, requiring optimized antenna design and signal processing for reliable communication.
